raw_sections.summary: Summary To leverage my 7+ years of experience in the networking domain as a Network Engineer, contributing to the design, implementation, and optimization of robust network infrastructures. I aim to utilize my technical expertise in enhancing network performance, security, ensuring seamless operations, and driving organizational success through innovative solutions and proactive support.
raw_sections.experience:
Professional Experience Resident Engineer (April 2025 – Present) HPE Juniper Networks, Gurugram, Haryana 122002
Analyzing network configurations. • Troubleshooting the network and supporting operations. • Developing network and equipment operating procedures. • Assisting with network inventory tracking and management to support the network. • Testing of Juniper Networks product features & functionality. • Evaluating technical specifications for interoperability. • Documents root cause analysis to help minimize future issues and maximize network uptime. • Oversee, monitor, and track open trouble tickets, return material authorizations (RMAs), and open bug reports.
Providing regular updates on current issues. • Providing informal technical and product workshops. • Assisting in the ongoing definition of Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) for the network and services. • Support to ensure that customer network continuously scale & evolve based on their organisation requirements & operational needs.
Technical Support Engineer-2 (July 2023 – March 2025) Juniper Networks, Karnataka IN
Hands-on experience and a combination of the following; designing, deploying, configuring, supporting, troubleshooting, debugging and administering the network protocols and technologies.
Managed Juniper's campus and data-center products (EX, QFX and IP-fabric) and associated technologies. • Acted as the primary point of contact for customer-reported issues & advocating for timely resolutions. • Ensure timely restoration of Services maintain MTTR for good customer experience & high Service availability to maintain Service Level Agreement (SLA).
Developed a deep understanding of infrastructure, technologies, configurations and service histories, provide

relevant technical inputs to facilitate and expedite escalated problem resolution. Identify and isolate product issues or reported problems at both hardware and software levels, replicate customer environments in JTAC lab for engineering engagement, own & document communications among customers, engineering teams and stakeholder, and provided final resolutions.
Hand-on experience on networking troubleshooting tools such as IXIA, tcpdump, and Wireshark. • Develop and maintain in-depth knowledge of IP products, including features, functionality, and technical specifications.
Utilize technical expertise to troubleshoot and debug IP product issues, collaborating with internal teams (Pre-sales, engineering) to improve potential quality issues with products & to ensure seamless customer experience
Non-Juniper
Technical Support Engineer (November 2021 – June 2023) Juniper Networks, Karnataka IN
Resolve customer concerns raised during installation, operation, maintenance, product application, or compatibility matters.
Be a customer advocate for timely resolution of the problems reported, understand the environment/network and impact on business.
Take ownership for problem resolution, problem reproduction and escalation. • Single Point of Contact (SPOC) for Level 1 escalations and elevated cases & escalating issues to next level engineers or management when necessary.
Troubleshoot problems with hardware equipment and software applications and recommend corrective action.
Created and updated technical documentation, such as knowledge base articles, to share expertise with internal teams and customers.
Provided mentorship to newly hired engineers, offering guidance and support. • Designed onboarding programs for Technical Assistance Center (TAC), focusing on switching curriculum for new hires worldwide.
Network Engineer (October 2018 – October 2021) WIPRO (IGI International Airport) Delhi
Managed network & security in Enterprises and data-center network with associated technologies. • Security Policy Development: Create and customize security policies to address specific application vulnerabilities and compliance requirements.
Hands-on experience on Fortigate firewall & Working knowledge of Palo-Alto firewall & Panorama. • Collaborate with the incident response team to investigate and mitigate security threats. • Incident Response: Monitor security events, analyze logs, and respond to security incidents in a timely manner.
Managed diverse vendors devices including Cisco, Avaya, and Arista, Juniper & Extreme Switches. • Proficient in Routing, Switching, Redundancy, and Discovery protocols. • Configured, maintained and monitored LAN/WAN networks and ensuring rapid incident resolution as per SLAs.
Optimized network performance through proactive monitoring, troubleshooting, outage management and upgrade scheduling in collaboration with network’s architects.
Utilized network tools such as Wireshark, Junos Space, EDM and DM. • BMC Remedy used for Change & Incident Management.
Hands On
Cisco: C9300, 4010 • Avaya: VSP9012, 7254XSQ, 5952, 5698, 5520, 3510 • Juniper: MX-Series, QFX-Series, EX-Series • Arista • Fortinet
